profile.headline: Full stack Developer
profile.summary:
Ø	Overall 20 years of IT experience in planning and executing development projects.
Ø	5 years developing web applications with PHP and MySQL.
Ø	8 years developing Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures.
Ø	Domain knowledge in Retail Consumers with clients like British American Tobacco Mex.
Ø	Deep knowledge of Oracle Database, good knowledge of MySQL. 
Ø	Strong experience creating Web Applications with Angular. 
Ø	Deep knowledge of development of Restful APIs.
Ø	Over 2 years working Java developer on technologies like Spring boot.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Build web application to support data analysis and visualization for enterprise.

•	Design and development an eCommerce Web Application with framework Angular (frontend) and Laravel (backend).
•	Understanding architecture to handle CakePHP 4.x Framework with MySQL.
•	Developing a RESTful API in Spring boot for CRUD operations.
•	REST Authentication and Security with JWT.
•	Design and document databases, improve queries performance.
•	Best practices for developing API's.
•	Using parameters via query, path, header, and body for API Pagination, Filtering and CRUD
•	Make RESTful requests using Postman.
•	Document an API with Swagger.
•	Create a Databases and users in MySQL.
•	Schedule data backups using MySQL dump.
•	Use JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML to write Angular applications.
•	Use Agile Scrum software development Methodology.
•	Version control with Git and GitHub.
•	Configuration of Nginx to deploy PHP applications.
•	Experience in using MantisBT tool for bug tracking, issue tracking.
•	Upload Angular Library packages to npm registry.
•	Upload PHP packages to packagist.
•	Restrict routes for unauthorised users.
•	Use of tools like NX Monorepo and PrimeNg Material Library.
•	Basic knowledge of Docker.
•	Conduct code reviews and participate in technical design.
positions.insights: Desarrollo de software, CakePHP and +4 skills

positions.title: Consultor
positions.description:
•	Involves in preparing Low Level design documents based on High Level documents.
•	Participates in meetings with Business Analyst’s to validate technical design solution.
•	Involves in providing production support monitoring/trouble shooting issues and handling new.
•	Leads, develops and implements upgrades packages under limited supervision.
•	Processing data migration with ETL Processes.
•	Responsible for the design and implementation of business solutions related with Siebel CRM.
•	Develops Siebel EIM tasks, Business Services and Workflows.
•	Develop of Siebel Business Services.
•	Programming with Oracle PL/SQL scripts including views, cursors, procedures, functions, database Trigger, isolated transactions.
•	Improve performance of queries through indexes.
•	Preparation of functional, and test case documents for the Siebel upgrades.
•	Install Siebel Servers on Windows environment.

positions.title: Consultor
positions.description:
Project coordination, identification of business needs, work plan, team time management and status reports.

•	Monitor system performance and establish controls, design alerts and preventive measures of 7 Servers with Siebel Consumer Goods.
•	Analyze complex business incidents, identify problems, track down required information and develop technical solutions according ITIL incident management.
•	Involved in the ITIL Change Advisory Board (CAB) that support the assessment, prioritization, authorization and scheduling of changes to the Siebel servers.
•	In charge of coordinating a team of 8 people.
•	Status update to the Project team on the System and Application Performance and Monitoring.
•	Participates in reviews of technical specifications, requirements, feature set, and functionality of systems.
•	Perform Siebel upgrades from 7.5.3 to 7.7.2.
•	Preparation of document for Disaster Recovery plan process of the Siebel Architecture. 
•	Document operation process.
•	Support business customers by providing insight into data warehouse structures.
positions.insights: Oracle SQL Developer, Estrategia de servicio ITIL and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
System developer.

•	Design and develop solutions for control of the manufacture of harnesses, automotive components and instruments.
•	Develop of webservices with C# (frontend) and SQL Server (backend).
•	Work closely with business analysts and project managers to provide technical design recommendation to meet business and IT needs.
•	Deploy web application in IIS.
•	Develop Object-oriented application consuming webservices.
•	Perform UAT testing for Go-No Decision.
positions.insights: Servicios web de RESTful, Microsoft SQL Server and +1 skill

company.name: MW Consulting S.A. de C.V. (now AXEN IT Consulting)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop a Stand-alone application to support of the Company ERP using Delphi with Object Oriented Programming.
•	Make reports using Oracle materialized views.
•	Develop and maintain Oracle database-related objects.
•	Design and develop the blueprint of Purchase business requirements.
•	Mapping the Sales rep compensation process and develop the solution. 
•	Experience with the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) process including requirement analysis, conceptual and detail design, development, verification and testing.
positions.insights: Borland Delphi and Oracle SQL Developer
